name: Ransomware Locks Administrative Systems
description: A ransomware actor encrypts the student information system, LMS, and finance systems mid-term, freezing registration, grading, and payments while systems are rebuilt.
asset: Student information, LMS, and finance systems
assumptions: Recovery takes 5–15 business days across systems.
An outage during registration or finals multiplies the impact.
Secondary loss covers enrollment attrition and notification duties.

name: Funded Research Data Breach
description: A targeted intrusion exfiltrates federally funded research data and lab system credentials, triggering sponsor notification and grant compliance consequences.
asset: Federally funded research data and lab systems
effect: Data exfiltration and grant compliance breach
assumptions: Only campaigns reaching funded-research systems are counted.
Primary loss covers investigation and sponsor-mandated remediation.
Secondary loss includes grant clawbacks and eligibility consequences.

name: Student Records Breach via Phished SSO
description: A phishing campaign captures single sign-on credentials and an attacker reads or exports protected student records before detection.
assumptions: A loss event is confirmed access to records beyond the phished account.
MFA coverage is reflected in the vulnerability estimate.
Secondary loss includes regulatory response and credit monitoring.

name: Financial Aid Payment Redirect
description: A fraud group impersonates students or a disbursement vendor and redirects tuition refunds or financial aid payments to attacker-controlled accounts.
assumptions: Only attempts reaching disbursement staff or self-service bank-detail changes count.
Bank recovery is reflected in the primary-loss estimates.
Secondary loss covers student remediation and audit findings.

name: DDoS During Registration Week
description: Extortion-motivated operators flood the registration portal during the peak enrollment window, degrading or blocking registration and payment flows.
asset: Registration portal and public web presence
effect: Portal outage in the peak week
assumptions: Off-peak attacks are absorbed; only peak-window outages are loss events.
Upstream scrubbing capacity is reflected in the vulnerability estimate.
Secondary loss covers extended support hours and late-enrollment concessions.
